description: CR 113.6m a cost's zone outranks an effect's other zone
note: docs/decisions.md, "Which zone an ability functions in when its cost and effect disagree". Synthetic Errant Courier's one ability costs discarding itself (the hand) and its effect returns itself from exile, so CR 113.6m names two zones, and no earlier part puts the card into exile to lift the second. Pawl lets the cost's zone answer, so the ability is activated from the hand; the rejected reading, functioning in neither zone, refuses the activation. Synthetic because no printing pairs a self-moving cost with an effect moving the same card out of a zone the cost does not put it into: MTGJSON AtomicCards of 2026-10-08, every activated ability whose cost discards, exiles, returns or sacrifices the card itself and whose effect moves the card itself, 2026-10-19, turned up only Kogla and Yidaro, whose effect moves the card out of the graveyard its discard put it into, which CR 113.6m's own exception settles. The draw is what shows the ability resolved; the card stays in the graveyard, as the exile move finds nothing there.
